To reach Excellent, deepen the objective arguments and make decision-making recommendations for several different stakeholders, not only Rachel and the company; strengthen the pro-shipping case and show how trade-offs are weighed.","C3":"Your logical structure supports the Not Ship conclusion, but the pro-shipping case is comparatively weak and the analysis is not systematic for all stakeholders. To reach Excellent, integrate a stakeholder-by-stakeholder analysis so each section builds the argument, and strengthen counterarguments before concluding.","C4":"You use relevant qualitative evidence and external cases such as the NHS/HSSIB example. To reach Very good, substantiate arguments with adequate references and some qualitative/quantitative evidence; for Excellent, add balanced in-depth evidence. Good requires limited visual elements and a few relevant references; Very good/Excellent require several visual types and extensive, relevant references."}}
